name: CityGaussian / VastGaussian / DoGaussian
definition: Divides the city into tiles, trains per tile, merges with overlap; uses LoD pyramid for streaming.
summary: CityGaussian, VastGaussian, and DoGaussian enable large-scale urban reconstruction by partitioning scenes into blocks, training independent 3D Gaussian Splatting models per block, and merging them at rendering time using a Level-of-Detail hierarchy.
